title: Reduce diagnostics state summary WebView flat exports
summary: Reduced the Diagnostics state-summary flat WebView export surface by removing three helper aliases while preserving namespace-backed read-only diagnostics evidence rendering.
reason: Continue the WebView flat-export cleanup workstream with a narrow Diagnostics-domain slice that keeps helper access namespaced and does not change backend mutation or diagnostics command behavior.
behavior_before: Diagnostics state-summary helper functions were exposed through mediaPipelineDiagnosticsStateSummaryView and as flat window aliases consumed by diagnostics display modules.
behavior_after: Diagnostics display modules consume diagnostics state-summary helpers through mediaPipelineDiagnosticsStateSummaryView, and diagnosticsStateRecommendedFirstAction, diagnosticsStateOperatorStatus, and diagnosticsStateRowStatusState are no longer published as flat window aliases.

rollback_plan: Restore the removed diagnostics state-summary flat window assignments and previous flat-window consumers, then regenerate WebView contract/command artifacts and summaries.
